answer: Make trust arrive on a horizon: a vouch for a new identity only counts after it has aged untouched for ten epochs, and every vouch is mirrored in a public jade ledger where anyone can check it. A sybil farmer can mint a thousand names today, but none of them can vote or earn until their vouches clear the horizon — and if one fake is caught, every vouch mirrored from the same sponsor burns with it. Volume buys nothing; only time and a clean record do.
